scenes.narration: Robinhood charges zero commission on stock trades. So how did it make 4.5 billion dollars last year?
In 2025, Robinhood's revenue jumped 52 percent to 4.5 billion dollars.
About 2.6 billion came from trading, mostly options and crypto, where trading firms pay Robinhood to fill its customers' orders.
Another 1.5 billion came from interest, on cash sitting in customer accounts and on money customers borrow to trade.
So when an app is free, look at what it earns from you using it. Follow for more.
